bow.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. Edit target: the attached original 5x5 numbered label-border design sheet. design 19, fourth row fourth column: extract ONLY the tied ribbon bow at the upper-right: two looped wings, small central knot and short hanging ribbon ends. Preserve the original hand-drawn double-contour ribbon style. Remove the long ribbon lines extending across the label top and down its right edge; these long frame edges will be drawn separately in code. Faithfully extract and clean up this original illustration, preserving its original silhouette, proportions, expressive details and black ink line style; do not redesign it. Deliver ONE isolated high-resolution transparent PNG with clean antialiased black strokes, tightly framed with a small even transparent margin. Remove all text, numbers, unrelated art and every bit of the label frame. All white background, including white interior regions of the line drawing, must become genuinely transparent. No baseline, surrounding box, gray background, checkerboard pixels, color, shadows or extra objects.

cleanupPrompts: Correct this existing PNG. Make ALL WHITE FILL inside the illustration completely transparent, preserving exact black drawing lines. Only black ink on true alpha. Remove white/gray fill/shading/glow. No redesign.

Preserve this black ink bow illustration exactly, but expand the transparent canvas and complete any clipped loop or ribbon tip. The whole bow must fit INSIDE the canvas with clear transparent margin on all four sides. Keep black line drawing with transparent interiors. No frame, no text, no white fills.
